headline: Approved $1,150,436.00 and $2,399,698.00 contracts with Constellations for special education ABA programs, plus other special education and curriculum contracts.
summary: The committee approved special education, curriculum, and staffing contracts. It also approved a staffing authorization for special education teacher vacancies and a June budget transfer report. A fiscal year 26 budget update was presented without a vote.
decisions: Approved five-year rewards agreements with BSN Sports and Under Armor, 2-0.
Approved purchase of SIPPS Literacy Curriculum from Collaborative Classroom, not to exceed $43,200.00, 2-0.
Approved 2026-27 contract with Newsela for the Formative Digital Platform for the high schools, not to exceed $32,442.56, 2-0.
Approved one-year agreement with Leaders Atlas for the Mosaic Storytelling Program, not to exceed $18,000.00, 2-0.
Awarded Constellations the Staffing and Management of Alternative Program with ABA for 2026-27, not to exceed $1,150,436.00, 3-0.
Awarded Constellations the Self-Contained ABA Program for 2026-27, not to exceed $2,399,698.00, 3-0.
Approved contract with White Birch for one full-time psychologist for 2026-2027, not to exceed $162,000.00, 3-0.
Approved contract with White Birch for one full-time APPIC Fellow and one Doctorate-Level School psychologist for 2026-2027, not to exceed $124,032.00, 3-0.
Approved three-year contract with Leap Learning for one full-time Bilingual psychologist for 2026-2027, not to exceed $168,750.00, 3-0.
Approved contract with Champion Speech Therapy for speech services at McCarthy Middle School during the 2026 ESY, not to exceed $14,033.25, 3-0.
Approved contract with ABC Physical Therapy for 2026-27, not to exceed $270,000.00, 3-0.
Approved contract with Clark Associate for 2026-27, not to exceed $976,522.50, 3-0.

Authorized the Chief Operating Officer to contract with additional qualified staffing agencies, if necessary, after August 1, 2026, to fill remaining special education teacher vacancies for 2026-27, 3-0.
Approved the FY26 June Transfer Report, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the five-year rewards agreements with BSN Sports and Under Armor. Motion passes 2-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the purchase of SIPPS Literacy Curriculum from Collaborative Classroom at a cost not to exceed $43,200.00. Funding to be charge to Operating Budget under Curriculum. Motion passes 2-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the 2026-27 contract with Newsela for Formative Digital Platform for the high schools at a cost not to exceed $32,442.56. Funding to be charge to Operating Budget under Curriculum. Motion passes 2-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the Superintendent to enter into a one-year agreement with Leaders Atlas to implement the Mosaic Storytelling Program for the 2026–2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $18,000.00. Motion passes 2-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to award Constellations the Staffing and Management of Alternative Program with ABA for the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $1,150,436.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Tuition. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to award Constellations the Self-Contained ABA Program for the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $2,399,698.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the contract with White Birch for staffing one full-time psychologist for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $162,000.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with White Birch for staffing one full-time APPIC Fellow and one Doctorate-Level School psychologist for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $124,032.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the three-year contract with Leap Learning for staffing one full-time Bilingual psychologist for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $168,750.00. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Champion Speech Therapy for speech services at McCarthy Middle School during the 2026 ESY at a cost not to exceed $14,033.25. Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Tuition. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the contract with ABC Physical Therapy for the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $270,000.00. Funding to be charged to account 91.1.022160 53614. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Clark Associate for the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $976,522.50. Funding to be charged to account 91.1.022160 53614. Motion passes 3-0.

Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to authorize Chief Operating Officer to contract with additional qualified staffing agencies, if necessary, after August 1, 2026, to fill remaining special education teacher vacancies for 2026-27 school year, with updates on any resulting contracts provided to the BOE. Motion passes 3-0.
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the FY26 June Transfer Report. Motion passes 3-0.

FINANCE & OPERATIONS COMMITTEE MEETING 
MONDAY, JULY 20, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Finance and Operations Committee was held at NHS North on Monday,  
July 20, 2026.  Ms. Lamphier called the meeting to order at 4:06 pm. 
 
Present:  Ms. Lamphier, Mr. Salvi, and Ms. Lewis (4:30 pm) 
 
Also Present:  Ms. De Gray, Dr. Andrade, Mr. Beer, Dr. Vincente 
 
Also Present:  Members of the Public, Channel 22 Videographer 
 
Athletics Uniform Agreement Approval 
• Ms. Gingras explains the agreement with BSN Sports and Under Armor, highlighting the benefits 
and obligations. 
• Ms. Lamphier and Mr. Salvi discuss the details of the agreement, including the financial aspects 
and previous agreements. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the five-year rewards agreements with BSN 
Sports and Under Armor.  Motion passes 2-0. 
 
 
Curriculum Purchases and Grant Updates 
• Dr. Scarpati provides an overview of the federal grant applications and planned activities for the 
coming year. 
• Specific activities under Title IV include professional development for teachers, literacy 
coaching, and curriculum development support. 
• Ms. Lamphier and Mr. Salvi ask questions about the programs and their implementation. 
• Dr. Scarpati proposes purchasing the SIPPS literacy curriculum, a tier-three literacy intervention 
for students that are significantly below level in reading. The purchase includes the curriculum 
materials, student books, and professional development from collaborative classroom for use as a 
tier-three intensive reading intervention.  
• SIPPS was piloted that at three of the buildings this past year, and this would be to outfit the 
remaining nine elementary schools. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the purchase of SIPPS Literacy Curriculum 
from Collaborative Classroom at a cost not to exceed $43,200.00.  Funding to be charge to Operating 
Budget under Curriculum.  Motion passes 2-0. 
 
• Dr. Scarpati proposes continuing our contract with Newsela at the secondary level for the 
formative digital platform, which is an all-in-one instructional tool that teachers use to build 
interactive lessons, check student understanding instantly, and provide real-time feedback. This 
platform has been in use at Nashua High North and South for the past few years. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the 2026-27 contract with Newsela for 
Formative Digital Platform for the high schools at a cost not to exceed $32,442.56.  Funding to be 
charge to Operating Budget under Curriculum. Motion passes 2-0.
FINANCE & OPERATIONS COMMITTEE MEETING  July 20, 2026 
2 
 
Mosaic Storytelling Program Approval 
• Dr. Andrade explains that Mosaic Storytelling Program is an interactive AI tool for storytelling 
that aligns with the district's strategic plan. 
• The program aims to improve communication and showcase the excellence happening in schools. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the Superintendent to enter into a one-year 
agreement with Leaders Atlas to implement the Mosaic Storytelling Program for the 2026–2027 school 
year at a cost not to exceed $18,000.00. Motion passes 2-0. 
 
Special Education Contracts 
• Mr. Beer and Dr. Vicente provide details on the two requests for proposals for the two separate 
ABA programs explaining the need for new bids and the results of the technical and cost 
comparisons. 
• The committee questioned the past year and the cost comparison. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to award Constellations the Staffing and Management of 
Alternative Program with ABA for the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $1,150,436.00.  
Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Tuition. Motion passes 3-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to award Constellations the Self-Contained ABA 
Program for the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $2,399,698.00.  Funding to be charged to 
the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 3-0. 
 
• The remaining special education contracts for school psychologists, bilingual school 
psychologist, speech services, physical therapy, and occupational therapy are discussed and 
approved. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the contract with White Birch for staffing 
one full-time psychologist for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed $162,000.00.  Funding 
to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services. Motion passes 3-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with White Birch for staffing one 
full-time APPIC Fellow and one Doctorate-Level School psychologist for the 2026-2027 school year at 
a cost not to exceed $124,032.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted 
Services.  Motion passes 3-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the three-year contract with Leap Learning 
for staffing one full-time Bilingual psychologist for the 2026-2027 school year at a cost not to exceed 
$168,750.00.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Contracted Services.  Motion 
passes 3-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Champion Speech Therapy 
for speech services at McCarthy Middle School during the 2026 ESY at a cost not to exceed 
$14,033.25.  Funding to be charged to the Operating Budget under Out-of-District Tuition.  Motion 
passes 3-0. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the contract with ABC Physical Therapy for 
the 2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $270,000.00.  Funding to be charged to account 
91.1.022160 53614.  Motion passes 3-0.
FINANCE & OPERATIONS COMMITTEE MEETING  July 20, 2026 
3 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the contract with Clark Associate for the 
2026-27 school year at a cost not to exceed $976,522.50.  Funding to be charged to account 
91.1.022160 53614.  Motion passes 3-0. 
 
Proactive Staffing Approval 
• Ms. De Gray introduces a memo regarding proactive staffing approval for special education 
teacher vacancies.  The memo requests the ability to engage with contract services agencies to fill 
vacancies proactively. 
• Ms. Lamphier and other board members express concerns about the lack of parameters and the 
need for transparency. 
• Dr. Andrade mentions the next board meeting is not until August 23.  The District needs to have 
the ability to fill the 14 required positions (district hire or contractor) prior to that meeting. 
• The committee discusses the importance of having qualified staff in front of students and the need 
for proactive measures and agrees to allow the administration to engage with agencies to fill 
vacancies, with a limit of $25,000 per contract and all contracts to be approved by the board. 
• Ms. De Gray confirms that the positions are budgeted in wages within the FY 27 budget. 
• Ms. Lewis suggests adding language to the motion to clarify the need for staff before the school 
year begins. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to authorize Chief Operating Officer to contract with 
additional qualified staffing agencies, if necessary, after August 1, 2026, to fill remaining special 
education teacher vacancies for 2026-27 school year, with updates on any resulting contracts provided 
to the BOE.  Motion passes 3-0. 
 
Credit Card Report  
• Ms. De Gray introduces the quarterly credit card report, noting the use of credit cards for 
immediate purchases. 
 
Budget Transfer 
• Ms. De Gray mentions a budget transfer for fiscal year 26 and asks for questions. 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Mr. Salvi, to approve the FY26 June Transfer Report.  Motion 
passes 3-0. 
 
 
Fiscal Year 26 Budget Update 
• Ms. De Gray presents a draft of the FY 26 budget spreadsheet to date, noting that the city has not 
closed the books yet. 
• The district is expected to use 99.72% of the overall budget, with an estimate of returning $1.3 
million in benefit money to the city of Nashua. 
• After benefits, the district will have about $166,892 remaining, with a $160,000 needed for a food 
service supplemental appropriation. 
• Contract services for special education are over budget by about a million dollars, with a total 
spend of $6.7 million. 
• Ms. De Gray mentions that out of district tuition will end up costing about 6.5 million dollars, 
with additional funds from special revenue. 
• Electricity costs were higher than budgeted, resulting in an overage of about $80,000 in property 
services.  
• Regular education transportation had a surplus, but special education transportation and 
McKinney-Vento costs were under budget.
FINANCE & OPERATIONS COMMITTEE MEETING  July 20, 2026 
4 
• Based on the current forecast, a supplemental appropriation for special revenue related to special 
education may not be needed.  Waiting to final close of FY26 to solidify. 
• Ms. Lamphier apologizes for any misunderstandings earlier in the meeting. 
 
 
Ms. Lamphier moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to adjourn at 5:35 pm.  Motion passes 3-0.  
 
Submitted by Tara C. Kinsella
